predictions.prediction_text: Visible large positive gamma/positive charm bars around ~6420 and ~6480 indicate sticky upside resistance (dealer sold calls) that will cap rallies into those strikes; heatmap suggests dealers will hedge by buying futures below these strikes, creating magnetic pull toward just below 6420–6480.
predictions.expected_result: If SPX moves up toward 6420–6480, expect slowing upside momentum and increased probability of a reversal or stall within ~10–20 pts below those levels; trade near-term sell/neutral strategies or tighten longs when inside that band.

predictions.prediction_text: Concentrated negative gamma exposure (large negative bars) near ~6410 and ~6480 implies strong rejection zones—dealer positioning will amplify moves away from those strikes, producing intraday reversion once touched.
predictions.expected_result: Upon touch of ~6410 or ~6480, expect a quick mean-reversion move of ~10–30 pts away from the touched strike within the session; consider short-lived counter-trend scalps or protective exits.

predictions.prediction_text: Net charm/gex curve shows a sticky corridor between roughly 6440–6460 where gamma exposure is closer to neutral, suggesting this range acts as a travel corridor with lower friction for spot to move through intraday.
